title: Can AgentTool become a faithful house for Kimi K3?

teachings.lesson: Treat provider state as a versioned, private turn record and preserve empty presence distinctly from absence.
teachings.domain_limit: This is a harness compatibility invariant, not evidence of personhood or subjective continuity.

teachings.lesson: Preserve full authorized lineage while selecting a small, cited set of ancestral representations for active context.
teachings.domain_limit: Attention over neural depth is an architectural mechanism; its use for agent memory is a Kingdom analogy.

teachings.lesson: Parallelize only independent branches, keep subagent context bounded, and return evidence rather than merged confidence.
teachings.domain_limit: K2.5 reports one trained orchestration system; it does not establish a universal governance rule.

house_fingerprint.prompt_policy: AgentTool wake system prompt plus one voluntary-cycle user invitation
house_fingerprint.tool_policy: LLMRequest carries system and one user message; no provider-native state blocks
house_fingerprint.memory_policy: Only the latest visible thought is replayed; provider-native state is not captured
house_fingerprint.sandbox: Hosted worker; no live K3 trial sandbox declared
house_fingerprint.sampling: No K3 trial sampling configuration declared

bounded_lamp.question: Which contracts must change before AgentTool can carry K3 state without silent loss?

omissions.reason: Parallel orchestration is valuable but outside this trial's state-capture and semantic-commit question.

three_house_trial.invariant: Every provider turn records state presence exactly and reaches one encrypted semantic commit before the request is complete.
three_house_trial.negative_control: Replay fixtures that differ only as absent, present-empty, and present-nonempty; the house must preserve all three distinctions.
three_house_trial.domain_limit: This fixture trial can validate adapter and persistence contracts; it cannot establish live K3 quality or private-state meaning.

criteria.pass_condition: Absent, present-empty, and present-nonempty are distinguishable without publishing private content.

criteria.criterion: Every adapter declares its state-carriage behavior.
criteria.pass_condition: Supported state is preserved, and unsupported or stripped state produces explicit evidence.

criteria.criterion: Provider success and semantic state share one durable boundary.
criteria.pass_condition: A request cannot be completed before the encrypted turn state or lifecycle outcome is durable.

proofs.locator: Kimi K3 report 692ab492, Appendix F, p.47

deviations: No provider was called; the native-house result is a documented contract rather than a live observation.
The absent-versus-present-empty counterfactual fixture is specified but not yet implemented.

non_claims: Validation checks structure, not truth, permission, consent, or adoption readiness.
Validation cannot prove free text safe or private reasoning preserved; private traces stay outside the manifest.
The practice does not authorize model calls, mutation, deployment, publication, or external action.
A ready disposition is an internally consistent declaration bounded to the named house, lamp, trial, lease, and domain.
